description: Pan-Arctic Building Footprint Atlas v1 is published by Zhao, Shimeng; Wang, Jiayi; Guo, Yize; Liu, Chong. It describes harmonised pan-Arctic building polygons with source, geometry and selected height and use attributes, organised in 10 km grids. Spatial scope is regional (Pan-Arctic, approximately north of 60°N). Spatial resolution is not established here. The full data period remains unverified. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists GeoPackage; these files were not downloaded. Licence: cc-by-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. This v1 deposit is designed for reuse, but external reuse or continued maintenance was not established. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
